title: 领星ERP MCP 连接配置
description: 连接您的领星ERP账号。X-Mcp-Key 仅存储在本机，由 WorkBuddy 在连接领星 MCP 服务时通过请求头注入。请勿向他人分享该密钥。
description_en: Connect your LingXing ERP account. Your X-Mcp-Key is stored locally and injected by WorkBuddy into the request header when connecting to LingXing MCP. Do not share this key.
docLabel: 如何获取领星 MCP 鉴权密钥？
docLabel_en: How to get a LingXing MCP authentication key

fields.label: X-Mcp-Key
fields.placeholder: 在领星ERP AI助手的「管理MCP」页面复制鉴权密钥
fields.placeholder_en: Copy the authentication key from Manage MCP in LingXing ERP AI Assistant
fields.description: 密钥与当前领星账号绑定，数据访问范围继承该账号权限；密钥泄露后请立即重新生成。
fields.description_en: The key is bound to your LingXing account and inherits its data permissions. Regenerate it immediately if exposed.
